turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Of course. With he, she and it, add -s or -es. And with consonant + y, use -ies: My brother studies at night.

Try this: The baby ___ (cry) at night.
Write only the verb.
